original_test_intent: Run the authoritative AMD GPU stress workload at a stabilized, condensation-safe 10C condition and compare complete per-target behavior to an approved quantitative specification, while retaining the MLperf-versus-GST source conflict.
original_method: Obtain workload decision; pin software/build/config and target selector; define duration plus metric oracle; transition chamber with humidity/dew-point controls and prove DUT sensor soak at 10C; preserve baseline; run the approved target-complete workload under thermal/power/watchdog monitoring; compare all metrics and error deltas; stop and safely return chamber/host state.
manual_activity: Performance and chamber owners choose MLperf/GST, approve pinned target/config/duration/oracle and cold transition/condensation controls, and own verdict.
required_inputs: Stable GPU UUID/BDF/device-selector map and utilization oracle
Duration and exact AMD metric/unit/aggregation/threshold matrix
safety_requirements: Do not build latest sources over an uncontrolled system
Do not run before workload/selector/oracle decision
Require dry stabilized DUT surface, not chamber-air setpoint alone
Monitor GPU thermal/power/driver/BMC and abort on moisture or fault indication
Preserve logs and return chamber through approved transition without auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Await decisions and validate immutable artifact/target/chamber gates
Capture cold transition and baseline evidence
Run one approved workload and produce metric comparison
Terminate, warm/restore safely and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve MLperf versus GST across variants
Approve 10C condensation-safe plan, disposition results and set verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Join immutable workload/config identity and per-GPU utilization/results with DUT temperature/humidity/dew point and a quantitative spec/error-delta table.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Chamber air can reach 10C before board surfaces; testing before dry soak risks condensation and invalid thermal attribution.

review_improvement: Keeps workload ambiguity visible and adds the cold-surface safety/evidence absent from generic GST execution.
independent_technical_reasoning: A cold benchmark result is invalid if the intended workload is unknown or only chamber air reached setpoint. MLperf and GST exercise different software and acceptance paths, while condensation can cause hardware faults unrelated to the measured GPU metric. Immutable artifacts, target-complete utilization and quantitative thresholds separate workload correctness from environmental safety and hardware response.
